page.layout: Single printed page of a chronological table: a left column of years (1492–1498) with lists of names set in italic, in ruled blocks, each block with its year in the margin at left; a right column of marginal summaries beside each block. A bracketed asterisk [*] stands below the last block, under the left column. Page number at the head, left of the names.

page.notes: Years 1492–1498 appear in the left margin beside each block (1492, 1493, 1494, 1495, 1496, 1497, 1498). The marginal summaries are set in smaller roman type in the right column; I have reproduced them as notes. Some italic names carry a superscript or flourish that is not fully legible; "Thezo" and "Iarges" are rendered as printed. Long s has been rendered as s. The bracketed asterisk [*] below the last block is a printed reference mark, kept as printed. Words in the right column with uncertain letters are not individually marked; the scan is faded in places, particularly the "Foedus O s t e r g o v m" line and the "Foxus" line.
